transformations.name: Value constraints and activation

transformations.name: Value sources

transformations.name: Ordered selection

transformations.name: Encoding shorthand
transformations.evidence: Unparameterized hasEncodingStep and shorthand normalize to the same ordered IR sequence; malformed forms and unsupported parameters reject. IR RDF uses an ordered list, preserving repeats.
